CheckTitle: Global session idle timeout is finite and short enough
Description: Checks broad global session rules for a finite idle timeout.
Risk: Long or missing idle timeouts increase risk from unattended browsers and stolen sessions.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Global Session Policy or Security > Okta Sign-on Policy.
2. Open the broad/default policy and edit the applicable rule.
3. Set the idle timeout or session expiration setting to a finite short duration.
4. Use a shorter duration for privileged or sensitive access paths.
5. Save and validate expected timeout behavior.

Recommendation.Text: Set a finite idle timeout on broad global session policy rules to reduce session theft risk.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
